newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, near standstill late, USDA said.

Limited test slaughter steers and heifers 1.00 higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,900 slaughter steers and 1,900 heifers; 26,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 19,200 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 1150 lbs 63.00. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00, few North Plains 65.00. Confirmed - 3,800 Week Ago - 20,600 Year Ago - 1,700
Wk to Date - 26,800 Week Ago - 68,900 Year Ago - 19,100
